reviews.comment: He's sooo nice and funny and enjoys teaching. His lectures are fun and engaging and the labs were easy. The TA was also amazing. Just remember to study because I always studied the night before and I never got above a C on the tests lol but everything else makes up for it. Show up to class and do the labs and the homework and you'll get an A

I have always hated science classes, but this one was great! Dr. Spilker made astronomy fun. Lectures were engaging, homework and labs weren't too hard (the TA was amazing), and the exam reviews helped a lot. Essays weren't fun, but feedback was helpful. Lots of extra credit—easy A if you show up and try!

If you can take ASTR 111, TAKE IT. I just took this class to fill a life science requirement, but it turned out to be my favorite class of the semester. If you attend the lectures/labs and study a little bit, you can EASILY get an A thanks to the extra credit. Not to mention the content is really fascinating and Spilker teaches it really well!

The GOAT Astro professor. If you show up to class, read the textbooks, and do the assignments, it's almost impossible to fail. Exams are easy when you pay attention. He's really funny and makes the lectures engaging. If you're even the slightest bit interested in astronomy as a whole, take this class.

I have no idea why his difficulty rating is a 1. This class is not an easy A. I studied for the tests and I still failed them. The lab grades are easy A's and they bring your grade up a lot, so there's that. But the tests are hard and there are 4 of them. If you're looking for an easy A I wouldn't recommend this class but he's an amazing professor

His homeworks are easy and if you study for the exam 2 days in advance you will have no problem. His lectures are the whole class. He always checks attendance but you only have to be there for 80% of the time to receive full credit. There are many extra credit opportunities. Hilarious and fun guy!!

I might be a little biased because I love astronomy, but this was one of the most fun and interesting courses I've ever taken. Attendance was a tiny part of the grade, but if I remember correctly you only had to attend like 80 or 90% of the lectures to get the full attendance grade, everything else was for a (little) extra credit. Great professor.

I cannot comprehend science (besides chemistry b/c that is concrete). Ended with an A overall b/c of dropped tests and LOTS OF EXTRA CREDIT. If you're like me and cannot understand science, GO TO CLASS, so you get attendance extra credit, also exam questions are sometimes said in lecture. Lab is easy. Fact-check EVERYTHING on your papers.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super kind Prof who really gets excited about his class and wants you to enjoy it too

He genuinely cares about his class asking for feedback after every lecture and test. The lectures were super engaging. His tests and homework are very fair to the curriculum taught in class and the labs were an absolute joy. Felt like I learned the details of broad subject I have only heard in passing previously. I could not recommend him enough!

Honestly, an amazing and fun guy who is super passionate about his field of study. He made learning about the most abstract grand things in the literal universe super intuitive and easy to understand. Tbh if you can take him PLEASE DO!

Wow! Such a fun instructor. Very intelligent but knows how to explain tough concepts in a simple way. Make sure to interact with him in-class, he is very fun to talk to. Offers reviews for all exams, the essays are straightforward! Homework was the hardest part for me, everything else was easy and understandable!

He is super fun and tries to make class that way too. Attendance is mandatory with a card quiz at the end of lecture. Tests are multiple-choice, ranking, and short answer which was difficult. he gives study guides, but they aren't much help. homework is online, and two essays about articles

Spilker is really good prof who cares about students, good at teaching, entertaining lectures. The worst part about the class is the lab. If you can take ASTR 101 instead for 3 hrs I highly recommend. Labs are not interesting and waste, but the labs very easy compared to other classes so if needed take it with lab.
Very fun prof, would take him for all of my ASTR classes if he taught them

Dr. Spilker was a very interesting professor and taught the class very well. I enjoyed every time I showed up to class because all of the lectures were engaging. The textbook is online and the homework is accessible through it, so it was extremely easy to cover what you missed and why. Make sure to show up to class because he does take attendance!

Spilker is so laid back and his class is really interesting. You only need 75% attendance and any more is extra credit. The lab is so easy it's a joke, and the tests are a breeze if you use the study resources. He really cares about his students and takes the time to learn your name. This will be the easiest 4 hr class you ever take.
He is very chill and loves socializing with his students. Easily accessible outside of class and overall a very amazing teacher. I would 100% take him again if i had the choice
